Experience

Industry experience, community development, and machine learning mentoring.

  1. AI Engineering Intern · PT. Bank SulutGo

    I deployed a private RAG assistant on bank servers with Ollama, n8n, and Supabase pgvector so staff could search internal information.

    Jun–Aug 2025
    Role details and photos

    I built and deployed an on-premises retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistant with Ollama, n8n, and Supabase pgvector. Inference and vector storage ran on bank servers so staff could search internal information locally.

    I also documented the system with use-case, sequence, and entity-relationship diagrams, including the connection between the Next.js frontend and AI backend.

  2. Development Lead · UNSRAT IT Community

    I led 12 contributors building SPARK, a web and mobile assistant with real-time chat and Indonesian voice services.

    Jul–Nov 2024
    Role details and photos

    As SPARK’s development lead, I led 12 contributors to deliver an AI conversational assistant for UNSRAT IT Community. The system combines Next.js and Flutter clients, a NestJS and Socket.IO backend, and Python speech services connected over gRPC.

    I coordinated web and mobile development and supervised the data team’s collection and analysis workflows.

    View SPARK project

  3. Committee Member · Machine Learning Division · UNSRAT IT Community

    I designed a six-month machine learning curriculum, taught workshops for 20+ members, and mentored five juniors on a chatbot project.

    Jan–Jul 2024
    Role details and photos

    I designed a six-month machine learning curriculum and led workshops for more than 20 members. I also mentored a team of five junior members through a chatbot project, from planning to implementation.
